deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that primary tumour deaths occur 'when the tumour occurs in a meningioma', treating meningioma as an anatomical site rather than as the primary tumour itself.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Only 10% of these deaths, generally, if they're occurring in things like the meningioma that I was telling you about or in the liver.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student reading the rewrite may incorrectly understand a meningioma to be an anatomical location or organ where a tumour develops, rather than a tumour of the meninges.

considerations.sourcePassage: Also ulceration, you saw that enormous cauliflower structure within the colon.
considerations.reason: The lecturer refers to an image shown to the audience ('you saw that enormous cauliflower structure'), which the rewrite rephrases as 'the enormous cauliflower-like structure seen within the colon', adapting visual presentation remarks to textbook prose.

considerations.sourcePassage: And this causes an immense amount of pain. Bone pain is terrible.
considerations.reason: The rewrite preserves both statements with appropriate punctuation ('causes an immense amount of pain; bone pain is terrible').
Omitted as an informal conversational remark/understatement.
